_comment: Canonical English catalog for web-console. Keys with a leading underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by codegen, parity tests, and unused-key audits. Runtime interpolation uses i18next syntax: {{count}}, {{name}}, etc.

integrationsSection.title: Integrations
integrationsSection.description: Configure external services and inspect provider availability from one place.

newPaneDefaultsSection.title: New pane defaults
newPaneDefaultsSection.description: Set the baseline look for every new terminal pane without affecting existing sessions.
newPaneDefaultsSection.plusButtonHint: Quick-tap action. The other moves to long-press.

workspaceSection.title: Workspace behavior
workspaceSection.description: Tune the overall terminal layout and how the mobile controls use limited screen space.
workspaceSection.mobileToolbarHint: Compact keeps a tighter footprint. Expanded shows more controls at once.
workspaceSection.minimapHint: Keep the grid overview visible while navigating larger layouts.
workspaceSection.wakeLockDefault: Prevent the device from dimming or locking while the console is open.
workspaceSection.wakeLockUnsupported: Your browser or connection doesn't support screen wake lock. A video-based fallback is being used instead.
workspaceSection.wakeLockDenied: Screen wake lock was denied — your device may be in power-save mode.
workspaceSection.localeHint: Sets the UI language. Right-to-left languages flip the layout direction.

sessionsSection.title: Sessions
sessionsSection.description: Inspect active terminals, change expiration policies, reorder panes, and jump directly to the pane you need.
sessionsSection.defaultsHint: These defaults pre-populate the launch dialog. You can override per session.
sessionsSection.openTerminalsHint: Sessions are server-side processes. Panes are their workspace views.

shortcutsSection.title: Shortcut profiles
shortcutsSection.description: Curate reusable launch commands so common tasks start in one click.
shortcutsSection.profilesHint: Launch templates for repeat terminal workflows.

voiceOutputSection.title: Voice output
voiceOutputSection.description: Choose the playback backend, verify hook status, and tune the current speaking experience.
voiceOutputSection.backendPreferenceHint: Auto picks the best available option for this environment.
voiceOutputSection.startMutedHint: When enabled, audio is muted on app load. Tap the speaker icon to unmute.
voiceOutputSection.testTtsHint: Play a short sample using the current backend decision.
voiceOutputSection.browserAudioBlocked: Blocked until you interact with the page
voiceOutputSection.lastHookRoutingNone: No Claude hook routing has been recorded yet
voiceOutputSection.lastHookAckNone: No Claude terminal acknowledgment has been recorded yet
voiceOutputSection.lastTailerRoutingNone: No Codex tailer routing has been recorded yet
voiceOutputSection.lastTailerAckNone: No Codex terminal acknowledgment has been recorded yet
voiceOutputSection.kokoroVoiceHint: Pick the Kokoro voice to use when Kokoro is active.
voiceOutputSection.summarizationDescription: Summarize long AI responses via Ollama before TTS playback. Full text is always preserved in the Messages view.
voiceOutputSection.summarizeToggleHint: When enabled, responses longer than the word threshold are summarized before being read aloud.
voiceOutputSection.wordThresholdHint: Responses with fewer characters than this are read in full (not summarized).
voiceOutputSection.summarizationLevelHint: Light preserves more detail; heavy gives a brief spoken overview.
voiceOutputSection.browserVoiceHint: Choose the browser speech synthesis voice.

voiceInputSection.title: Voice input
voiceInputSection.description: Control how voice capture works, validate available backends, and tune streaming for responsiveness.
voiceInputSection.voiceInputHint: Enable speech-to-text controls throughout the workspace.
voiceInputSection.autoStopHint: Stop recording automatically when speech ends in tap mode.
voiceInputSection.silenceTimeoutHint: How long to wait after speech stops.
voiceInputSection.languageHint: Use auto-detect unless recognition quality is better with a fixed language.
voiceInputSection.persistentDescription: Keep the microphone active until you tap it again. Speak naturally — pauses trigger high-quality retranscription. Say a command prefix to execute terminal actions.
voiceInputSection.persistentModeHint: Toggle always-on listening. Requires Whisper streaming backend.
voiceInputSection.wakeWordSectionDescription: Record a custom wake phrase that opens the mic without tapping. Works in any mode — including one-shot — as a secondary way to start; tapping the mic still works exactly as before.
voiceInputSection.wakeWordHint: Record a custom wake phrase to activate voice hands-free. Matching is acoustic — by sound, not spelling — so any phrase works, dictionary word or not.
voiceInputSection.wakeWordRequireSaveFirst: Record and save a wake word below before enabling.
voiceInputSection.wakeWordRecordingHelp: Record {{min}}–{{max}} samples of your wake phrase. Detection compares the sound of your voice, not the words — so pick a distinctive 3–4 syllable phrase like “Hey Vrooli”, say it the same way each time, and record where you’ll normally use it.
voiceInputSection.sensitivityHint: The match score reflects how consistently you repeat your wake phrase — say it the way you did when enrolling and it scores higher. Lower values accept looser matches; higher values require a closer match.
voiceInputSection.minSamplesNeeded: Record at least {{min}} samples before saving.
voiceInputSection.wakeWordReRecordNeeded: These samples were loaded without their audio. Please re-record them before saving.
voiceInputSection.wakeWordSaved: Saved! Wake word is now active.
voiceInputSection.testNeedSamples: Need at least 2 samples to test.
voiceInputSection.liveTestHelp: Hold the button and speak your wake word to see if it triggers. Adjust the sensitivity slider above to tune results.
voiceInputSection.liveTestEmpty: Record and save samples above to enable live testing.
voiceInputSection.segmentSilenceHint: How long a pause triggers segment retranscription.
voiceInputSection.voiceCommandsHint: Say your wake word, then speak a command:
voiceInputSection.voiceConfigUnavailable: Voice config not available. Start the voice streaming backend to configure persistent mode.
voiceInputSection.performanceDescription: Reduce the delay between tapping the mic button and recording start. Useful for hands-free and persistent mode workflows.
voiceInputSection.lowLatencyHint: Pre-warms the microphone so recording starts instantly. Your OS will show a microphone indicator even when not recording. The mic is automatically released when you switch tabs.
voiceInputSection.speakerDescription: Filter out background speakers by only accepting segments that match your enrolled voice.
voiceInputSection.resourceUnavailable: Install and start the speaker-verification resource to use voice filtering.
voiceInputSection.useSpeakerHint: Only accept dictation that matches any of your enrolled voice profiles.
voiceInputSection.enrollFirst: Enroll a voice profile before enabling speaker verification.
voiceInputSection.activeProfilesHint: Audio is accepted if it matches any of the active profiles below.
voiceInputSection.noActiveProfiles: No active profiles. Enroll a voice below.
voiceInputSection.modeHint: Filter rejects by default. Advisory keeps transcripts but still reports mismatches.
voiceInputSection.thresholdHint: Higher values are stricter and reject more borderline segments.
voiceInputSection.enrollmentHelp: Record 10-20 seconds in a quiet environment. Read the following in your normal voice:
voiceInputSection.enrollmentScript: “The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the sun sets behind the distant mountains. She sells seashells by the seashore and watches the waves crash against the rocky cliffs. Every morning I enjoy a warm cup of coffee before heading out to start my day.”
voiceInputSection.shortcutHint: Capture a keyboard combo to start voice input quickly.
voiceInputSection.backendAvailabilityHint: Confirm which recognition engines are ready in the current environment.
voiceInputSection.noBackendWarning: No transcription backend available. Install Whisper or use a Chromium-based browser for Web Speech API.
voiceInputSection.micAccessHint: The browser must allow microphone access before voice recording can start.
voiceInputSection.micBlockedHelp: Microphone access was blocked. Click the lock or site-settings icon in your browser's address bar to allow microphone access, then refresh.
voiceInputSection.flushIntervalHint: How often audio is sent to Whisper.
voiceInputSection.minChunkHint: Minimum buffered audio before a partial transcript fires.
voiceInputSection.overlapHint: Keep a small trailing overlap so word boundaries survive chunking.
voiceInputSection.testMicHint: Record a short clip to confirm which speech-to-text backend is actually running. Three are possible: Whisper streaming (live, via audio-tools), Whisper batch (single POST at stop), and Web Speech (browser-native; Chrome → Google).
